misc.passkeys.title: Security · Passkeys
misc.passkeys.intro: Confirm your sign-in code before changing passkeys. Your account, content, and code are retained.
misc.passkeys.remove_confirm: Remove this passkey? Make sure you have saved your sign-in code.
misc.passkeys.account_confirmed: The account is confirmed. You can now change passkeys.
misc.security.heading: Passkeys and account recovery
misc.security.intro: A passkey lets you sign in with your device or password manager. Your device decides whether you use your face, fingerprint, or code. HerEme never receives biometric data or the private key.
misc.security.existing_body: Sign in with your username and sign-in code. Open the profile menu and choose “Security · Passkeys”. Confirm the code if prompted, then choose “Add passkey”. This retains the same account, posts, conversations, and roles.
misc.security.backup_body: Your sign-in code gives you access if your passkey is lost. Store it safely. You can register multiple passkeys and name or remove them. A synced passkey may be available on multiple devices.
misc.security.address_body: Production passkeys apply to hereme.no. A key registered on localhost or another address cannot be moved to hereme.no. Use your existing sign-in code to sign in and register a new passkey.
misc.security.roles: Passkeys do not verify real-world identity and do not change moderator or administrator privileges.
misc.privacy.heading: Privacy
misc.privacy.intro: HerEme lets everyone read without an account. When you participate, we store your username, secure session and recovery fingerprints, posts, votes, comments, uploaded media, and reports. Operations may record limited security and moderation events without secrets or post text.
misc.privacy.purpose_body: The information is used to provide the conversation, prevent abuse, handle reports, and restore the service. We do not collect BankID, national identity numbers, GPS, or inferred residence in v1. Security events are normally retained for 30 days; moderation audit records are retained as long as accountability requires.
misc.privacy.notifications_body: If you enable push notifications, HerEme stores the device subscription and encryption keys created by your browser. Lock-screen notifications contain only brief general text and an internal route—never message text, attachment names, sign-in codes, or login tokens. You can disable that device and choose categories in the profile menu. The delivery queue is retained for up to 30 days. Subscriptions are stored in the protected database and therefore in encrypted or otherwise access-restricted operational copies.
misc.privacy.choices_body: You can deactivate your account. A local operator can anonymize public authorship and remove personal data after a controlled request. Conversation threads and a minimal moderation audit may be retained where necessary for context and safety.
misc.privacy.recovery: If you lose both your session and sign-in code without another factor, the account cannot be securely recovered.
misc.privacy.disclaimer: This describes product operations and is not legal advice. Before public launch, the responsible owner must complete the relevant Norway/EEA assessment.
misc.rules.heading: Community rules
misc.rules.one: Share local content that you have the right to publish.
misc.rules.two: Do not publish harassment, threats, personal data, fraud, or illegal content.
misc.rules.three: Clearly label uncertain claims and do not impersonate others.
misc.rules.four: Use the report action within the post. The reporter is not shown publicly.
misc.rules.five: Three independent reports may temporarily hold a post for manual review.
misc.rules.moderation_body: An operator can publish, hide, or dismiss reports. Request another manual review through the forum's stated contact channel. A later release must show the actual responsible contact address before public launch.
misc.locations.unavailable: Map data is unavailable. Use the area list.
misc.locations.intro: Choose the areas you want to follow. Posts without a location remain visible.
